clips.title: The story
paras: In Teldrassil, Athridas Bearmantle seeks to wake the Druids of the Talon from their unnatural sleep. Their kin remain trapped in the Barrow Den, and the corrupted Gnarlpine chief behind the disturbance must be slain.

The Druids of the Talon withdrew to the Barrow Den of Ban'ethil to sleep and commune with the Emerald Dream. Their peaceful trance became a prison with no way back to waking. Athridas Bearmantle traced the trouble to the gnarlpine furbolgs, and to their vicious leader, Ursal the Mauler, who meddled with the druids' sacred ritual. The sleepers remain caught between waking and the Dream.

Athridas needs more than the Relics of Wakening to reach the druids through the spiritual fog. The source of the interference must be ended. Ursal the Mauler makes his lair in Gnarlpine Hold, the tribe's home in far southwestern Teldrassil. Striking down the furbolg warlord breaks his hold on the sleepers' minds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now the time has come to save the Druids of the Talon. If we fail now, friend, they will be forever lost in sleep.

I shall prepare the Relics of Wakening and perform the ritual. For my work to take effect, the cursed beast responsible for this horrible situation must be slain. Only then will the ritual be complete.
It was Ursal the Mauler who meddled with our brethren's calling and it is Ursal the Mauler who must now pay so they can be freed. Travel to Gnarlpine Hold in the southwest and slay him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Our brethren cannot be awakened until Ursal the Mauler has been slain, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend you have proven yourself a most worthy and able adventurer. A traveler who follows the path of honor as sure as you do is certain to find great glory in this world.
May the forest spirits protect you wherever your travels may take you.
